kurz: Spices are concentrated scent compounds. Many dissolve in fat, evaporate in heat and burn quickly.
bild_im_kopf: Like perfume bottles: left open they fade; warmed properly they open up.
was_passiert: Ground spices lose their aroma faster than whole ones because their surface is larger. Heat releases aromas; too much heat destroys them.
faustregeln: Buy whole spices and grind them fresh.
